label: Basketball
headline: Yes, I can keep talking basketball.
description: Pickup is one of my favorite ways to spend time. I follow the NBA, and Steph Curry is the player I look to for inspiration.

label: Faith
headline: Something that keeps me grounded.
description: I'm Ethiopian Orthodox Christian. Faith is part of how I try to live, and I enjoy thoughtful conversations about it.
prompt: What has your faith taught you lately?

label: Ethiopian roots
headline: Ethiopian roots. Maryland home.
description: Being Ethiopian-American is part of my story. Culture, community, and the conversations between different worlds matter to me.
prompt: What's something you love about Ethiopian culture?

label: Fitness
headline: A little stronger, a little more consistent.
description: The gym is part of my week. I'm interested in building habits I can actually keep, on and off the court.
prompt: What's your favorite way to train?

label: Technology
headline: Sometimes I just have to build the idea.
description: I like turning a random idea into working software, then figuring out how to make the systems behind it reliable.
prompt: What would you build if you had a free weekend?

label: Ancient wisdom
headline: Old questions. Still very relevant.
description: I'm drawn to philosophy and ancient wisdom, especially questions about attention, character, faith, and how to live well.
prompt: What's an idea that changed how you see life?

label: New places
headline: There is more to see around here.
description: I'm trying to explore more of the DMV and say yes to more experiences. A good local recommendation is always welcome.
prompt: What's an underrated place around the DMV?

label: Good conversations
headline: We can skip the perfect opening line.
description: Life, relationships, sports, faith, ambitious ideas, or figuring out our 20s. I like a conversation that goes somewhere.
prompt: What are you trying to figure out in your 20s?
